2026_01_CHI_CAR.headline: Chicago’s explosive offense tests Carolina’s rebuilt pass rush
2026_01_CHI_CAR.paragraph1: Chicago arrives with Caleb Williams directing Ben Johnson’s offense after the Bears finished last season among the league leaders in explosive plays. Carolina added Jaelan Phillips to a pass rush that needed more disruption, but Patrick Jones II is unavailable and the Panthers must also account for Chicago’s tight ends and play-action structure. Bryce Young’s best counter is to keep Carolina ahead of the chains and avoid feeding a Bears defense that generated turnovers at a high rate last season.
2026_01_CHI_CAR.model_rationale: Chicago can create stress through explosive plays and formation versatility, while Carolina needs clean early downs, ball security and consistent pressure to prevent the Bears from controlling tempo.
